title: Restore WebView detail shortcut visibility
summary: Restored WebView keyboard detail shortcut visibility for Queue, Completed, and Pending Publish selected-row detail blocks by making data-visual-keep explicit and honoring it in the shared prose-box disposition classifier.
reason: The browser-backed large-table smoke could select rows and render detail text, but the d shortcut failed because runtime prose-box disposition marked the detail target hidden, leaving it unfocusable.
behavior_before: Queue, Completed, and Pending Publish selected-row detail prose blocks could be populated with row evidence but then hidden by the prose-box disposition pass, so the d keyboard shortcut returned false before focus in the browser large-table smoke.
behavior_after: The selected-row detail blocks carry data-visual-keep="copy-output", the shared prose-box disposition classifier treats that marker as defended/visible, and the d shortcut can focus the populated detail targets in browser validation.
tests_added: Strengthened LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert rendered selected-row detail blocks carry data-visual-keep="copy-output".
manual_validation: Baseline before fix: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke -q failed at Queue detail shortcut with detailDisplay none.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet's WebView partial, dom/text.js, rendered HTML test, generated-summary, and packet changes; rerun the large-table browser smoke to confirm the previous shortcut failure is restored only if rollback is intentional.
